blocks.text: A god-mode authoring tab in the top-right rail. God-mode only: the play-mode ui HUD is a separate surface, untouched. Tabs are ordered, and each starts closed: a press on a tab opens its panel, and a second press closes it. Each tab is ONE script module: its default export is `render(ctx, player)…

CreatorTabDef = { id: string // Stable id: selection + lifecycle key. title: string // Tab title shown in the rail. icon: string // Icon: emoji or CDN url. script: ScriptRef // The panel module (default export = render; optional named onMount/onDestroy). shortcut?: string // Optional keyboard shortcut to focus/toggle the tab. }
